messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE: PAGERDUTY: [P1] service=serving-eu-west-az3 - elevated 5xx rate + control-plane heartbeat loss detected. link: <https://redwood.incidents/1735554321> details: 5xx spike starting ~03:10Z, control-plane heartbeats missing on 4 hosts, automated divert recommended.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-38654 triggered and notified to @eva-oncall. Escalation policy: 5m -> lead -> eng-sre.

eva-oncall: ack — I'm on it. pulling logs and routing table now.

ashlee.k: seeing kvcache evictions around 03:09-03:11. az3-10 reporting repeated gRPC connection resets, tagging infra.

sanjay.r: confirming telemetry — shard connections for m-3b-quant drop to 0 intermittently. looks like NIC flapping or host-level egress issue.

mike.t: do we have customer impact yet? which tenants are affected?

eva-oncall: yes — 5xx and latency >500ms for requests routed to az3. 3 Dedicated customers are hitting timeouts. I'm initiating regional divert to eu-west-az4 now.

joanna.l: please follow the divert runbook. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note once we confirm mitigation.

ashlee.k: running quick divert command now:
```
/runbook divert-region --from=eu-west-az3 --to=eu-west-az4 --model-group=prod-llm --ramp=30pct/2m --reason="auto-pd-az3"
```

incident-bot: Runbook started by ashlee.k — step 1: update routing weights submitted.

eva-oncall: divert rolling out. shifting ~30% -> 70% over 2m windows, watching error budget and p50/p95 latency.

sanjay.r: also enabling control-plane fallback: policy=use-variant-quantized for shard m-3b to reduce memory footprint and reconnect churn.

mike.t: acknowledged. I'm pinging support and CS to prep comms. @joanna.l can you draft the status blurb?

joanna.l: draft: "We're experiencing degraded performance and elevated errors in eu-west-az3. Traffic is being diverted to eu-west-az4; mitigation is underway. No data loss is expected. We'll update within 30-45 minutes or sooner if things change."

eva-oncall: error rate is dropping for diverted traffic — ~62% reduction so far. az3 hosts still show NIC resets on a subset. escalating to infra + cloud provider.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation routed to infra-oncall (sanjay.r) and cloud-provider-support per runbook.

ashlee.k: pulled dmesg and kernel logs from az3-10/11 — repeated NIC link reset every ~90s with VF errors. opening a ticket with provider and attaching logs.

joanna.l: posted initial status update to status.redwood.ai (INC-38654). linking internal advisory to affected tenants.

mike.t: should we enable manual tenant failovers for the 3 Dedicated customers? ops policy says offer manual failover if automated divert doesn't stabilize in 20m.

eva-oncall: not yet — automated divert is holding, but if control plane remains unstable for another 20m we'll trigger full AZ failover for affected Dedicated tenants. leaving channel after next update; handoff to night ops in ~40m.

incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE update: mitigation in progress — traffic diverted to eu-west-az4, observed 5xx rate decrease and latency improvement for diverted traffic. Next automated check in 5m.

eva-oncall: handing visibility to @ops-rotation for monitoring and customer follow-ups. will post a final timeline update in 30m.

ops-rotation: standing by. thanks team.
